user.title: Select your LevelMate Pro
user.description: The LevelMate Pro doesn't advertise its service in a way we can auto-filter, so every nearby Bluetooth device is listed. If you don't see yours (or it's asleep), choose "Enter address manually...".

manual_address.title: Enter the LevelMate Pro's Bluetooth address
manual_address.description: If setup can't find your device, it may be asleep - the LevelMate Pro powers down its radio after a period of no motion and only wakes on motion or a power-switch cycle. Try moving the RV slightly or cycling the unit's on/off switch, then enter its address below (format AA:BB:CC:DD:EE:FF).

parameters.title: LevelMate Pro parameters
parameters.description: These are written to the device itself, the same as the official LevelMate Pro app's setup wizard.

data.orientation: Mounting orientation (which way the label faces)
data.driving_side: Which side of the road you drive on

abort.no_devices_found: No Bluetooth devices were found nearby.

error.device_not_found: That address wasn't seen by Home Assistant's Bluetooth integration. Make sure the LevelMate Pro is powered on and awake (cycle its switch or move the RV), then try again.
